names: Terry A Francois Boulevard Paseo (Pier 48 entry)
summary: Planned conversion of Terry A Francois Boulevard between Block K and Pier 48 into a paseo. The Design Controls say it 'will become a paseo that will accommodate emergency vehicle access for up to 150' of its length', with a 28 ft waterfront zone at Pier 48 and a vehicular turnaround with one loading space. No source read describes its current use.

milestones.text: Final Design Controls (document dated April 24, 2018) says Terry A Francois Boulevard between Block K and Pier 48 'will become a paseo' (Section 4.3.4)

facts.value: A 28 ft waterfront zone next to the Pier 48 bulkhead carrying the Bay Trail / Blue Greenway plus additional public space for Pier 48; a vehicular turnaround with one loading space; a 6 ft minimum pedestrian path at Block K

sources.title: Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24, 2018 (final; Section 3 open spaces, Figure 3.1.1)

Informational presentation on updates to the Mission Rock Development Project, including efforts to accelerate Phase 2, with possible action on a Port Capital investment of $10 million (Port Commission Item 11A, Resolution 26-34)

open_questions: Current use and any construction schedule are not stated in any source read.
